## Open-Source Projects
- [ORV-Reader](https://orv.pages.dev): A web-publishing platform that compiles Markdown into fast static pages and EPUBs. Built to be clean and lightweight way to read stuff on slow connections. Source: https://github.com/Bittu5134/ORV-Reader
- [PeerBasket](https://peerbasket.bittu.dev): A hassle-free, lobby-based PeerJS discovery server written in Go  that handles peer discovery for real-time p2p interactions and multiplayer sessions. Source: https://github.com/Bittu5134/PeerBasket
- [GH-Follow-Tracker](https://follow.lazybittu.workers.dev/): A little service on Cloudflare Workers that tracks GitHub followers and generates live SVG badges, with Discord/Slack alerts when things change. Source: https://github.com/Bittu5134/GH-Follow-Tracker
- [LOTM-Reader](https://beyonder.pages.dev): A community driven webnovel reader built with Svelte, with offline caching and a tons of optimizations.  Built to be faster and cleaner than what was out there. Source: https://github.com/Bittu5134/LOTM-Reader
- [NetShip](https://github.com/Bittu5134/NetShip): A host telemetry agent in Go that watches socket activity and maps out process trees. Built it to understand how endpoint detection tools actually work under the hood.
- [Sharelock](https://github.com/Bittu5134/Sharelock): A retrieval system that lets you just ask questions about IIT Kanpur's academic policy manual instead of reading the whole thing. Built as a RAG pipeline with an MCP server.
- [InfraPulse](https://infrapulse.bittu.dev): A defect-detection tool that flags and prioritizes infrastructure issues from photos using a small vision-model ensemble. Built for a campus hackathon. Source: https://github.com/Bittu5134/InfraPulse
- [Resume-Model](https://iitk-resume.bittu.dev): A tool that parses academic PDFs by their layout geometry (since normal parsers choke on tables) and scores them. Built for IIT Kanpur's career office. Source: https://github.com/Bittu5134/IITK-Resume-Model

- [Scaling WebRTC Signaling in Go: Lessons from 500 Concurrent Peers](https://bittu.dev/blogs/scaling-webrtc-signaling-in-go.md): A deep dive into building PeerBasket low-latency signaling server in Go. How we achieved 41ms average latency and 0% packet loss across 500 concurrent peers with Redis TTL heartbeat pruning and IP token buckets. [Go, WebRTC, Redis, Networking] — 3 min read. Rendered HTML: https://bittu.dev/blog/scaling-webrtc-signaling-in-go
- [Reverse Engineering the Modern Minecraft Network Protocol](https://bittu.dev/blogs/reverse-engineering-minecraft-protocol.md): Unpacking the binary wire format of Minecraft Java Edition. From variable-length integers (VarInt) and zlib packet compression to handshake state machines and live packet sniffing. [Minecraft, Reverse Engineering, Protocols, C++] — 3 min read. Rendered HTML: https://bittu.dev/blog/reverse-engineering-minecraft-protocol
- [Coordinate Geometry in PyMuPDF: Extracting Unruly Academic LaTeX PDFs](https://bittu.dev/blogs/spatial-geometry-parsing-in-pymupdf.md): Why standard PDF parsers struggle with academic transcripts and resumes, and how we solved it for CDW IIT Kanpur using 2D spatial coordinate clustering and step-gradient scoring. [Python, PyMuPDF, Algorithms, AI] — 3 min read. Rendered HTML: https://bittu.dev/blog/spatial-geometry-parsing-in-pymupdf
